items.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest was a big buyer of Anthropic during debut
items.description: Wood's firm bought $90.8 million worth of Anthropic in six funds, according to a trade notification from the firm.

items.title: The Tech Download: Anthropic charmed Wall Street. But one big uncertainty hangs over the business
items.description: Access to the huge quantities of compute the company needs to continue developing and deploying models is a challenge for Anthropic to navigate.

items.title: Rejecting cheap fabrics, higher prices: Why shoppers are asking for better clothes
items.description: Retailers are charging higher prices for clothing made with cheaper materials. Shoppers are taking notice and experts say it could shift how they spend.

items.title: Anthropic defies the odds, holding record IPO despite ‘massively disruptive’ market
items.description: Anthropic faced a market selloff, raging anti-AI sentiment and a crisis at Nvidia in pulling off the largest IPO on record.

items.title: White House replaces cyber director Sean Cairncross amid widespread tech outages
items.description: Sean Cairncross will be replaced by Pentagon chief information officer Kirsten Davies.

items.title: Kushner says Russia 'comfortable' with idea of NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine
items.description: Kushner said President Donald Trump is open to such a guarantee, but its form and whether Russia and Ukraine would accept it remain unclear.

items.title: Putin scores ‘massive win’ at first trilateral meeting, rebuilding standing as Ukraine war grinds on
items.description: Putin was positioned as an equal beside the leaders of the U.S. and China, handing a win to the authoritarian leader bogged down in a multi-year war.

items.title: SoftBank suffers worst day in over two years as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks
items.description: The declines in Asia come after the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite fell more than 2% overnight following Anthropic's highly anticipated Wall Street debut.

items.title: ‘More than just a game’: How GTA VI’s blockbuster launch fuels a booming content economy
items.description: GTA VI’s blockbuster launch is creating a wider economy around livestreams, social clips and high-volume content farms as millions tune in to watch others play.

items.title: Forget Anthropic: In Europe, the IPO hype is about a blue lagoon
items.description: Iceland’s famed Blue Lagoon geothermal spa is going public in a $110 million IPO, tapping investor interest in tourism and the booming wellness industry.

items.title: AI is changing software engineering — and some developers miss the struggle
items.description: AI coding tools are making software engineers faster, but developers tell CNBC the work has lost its "sense of joy and fun."

items.title: U.K.-India trade deal faces a stiff test over Scotch whisky import taxes
items.description: In the global spirits markets, while the U.S., Europe, and China are facing volume contraction, India will add nearly 100 million consumers in the next five years.

items.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need,' but analysts warn of volatility
items.description: The Anthropic IPO is "what the markets need." However, analysts say its shares will be volatile in the coming weeks.

items.title: Senate passes BAAJA permitting reform bill backed by AI, energy sectors
items.description: The permitting bill's Senate passage is a key step to it becoming law, but it would also need to clear the House before heading to President Trump's desk.

items.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
items.description: The core inflation figure — which strips out prices of food — was lower than the 2.3% expected by Reuters-polled economists.

items.title: Commerce approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, Rep. Mast says
items.description: Members of Congress have pushed in the wake of the Jensen Huang scandal for legislation to tighten export controls on chip sales to China.

items.title: AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure
items.description: AMD closed down over 7% after a short seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. AMD said it complies with U.S. law.

items.title: Gap names new Athleta CEO, lowers full-year guidance
items.description: Gap on Thursday announced Ashley Kechter as the new CEO of Athleta. The retailer also reported mixed fiscal third-quarter earnings.

items.title: Lumentum CEO defends Marvell deal after stock plunge: 'We've got work to do' with shareholders
items.description: Lumentum CEO defended the planned Marvell merger despite stock sell-off.

items.title: Congress passes bill to protect older investors from financial fraud
items.description: Both chambers of Congress have now approved the Financial Exploitation Prevention Act of 2025, which is aimed at protecting vulnerable investors from fraud.
